output.title: ServiceAccount annotation template fix: annotation values not shown
output.content: The fix changes the Helm chart's service account template so boolean values work in annotations. The environment is deployed via Helm-based products (flux-helmrelease, argocd-application, helmfile), but the values keys listed contain no serviceAccount annotation key. Whether any annotations are set through other values is not visible. Check your chart values for service account annotations that use boolean values.
